summary: Backend-only validation of the P0 locked Roof Sketch viewer fix. Ran pytest suites for the sketch service + live sketch API + mobile measurement sync, and the mobile pure-Node test chains (yarn test:sketch, yarn test:measurements). All targeted contracts pass: GET on a locked revision succeeds (get_sketch has no editability gate), PUT on a locked revision returns HTTP 409 with 'locked' message, stale document_version returns 409 with server state, mobile locked-viewer regression suite passes (9 assertions in 'P0 LOCKED ROOF SKETCH VIEWER' + 9 in 'SKETCH OPEN DECISION' covering: existing locked sketch + currentSketchMutation() throw -> viewer still initializes with full geometry / no mutation queued / never stuck on 'Locked'; locked cached sketch offline; locked+no sketch -> empty_readonly; real load failure with no cache -> retryable error; editable sketch opens normally). No regression in the measurement suites from the new sync.js recordSketchViewerDiagnostic export.
critical_code_review_comments: get_sketch (backend/services/measurement_sketches.py L88-92) correctly has no is_editable() gate — read-only viewing of a locked revision is allowed as required.
save_sketch (L101-105) raises HTTPException 409 with 'This measurement revision is locked...' — matches the contract 'locked' substring the live pytest and mobile viewer both key off of.
Fault isolation in RoofSketch.js init effect (resolveFieldSketchViewerOpen) is well-covered by pure-Node regression: currentSketchMutation() throwing no longer strands the screen on 'Locked'.
seed_data_creation: Live smoke test self-creates and self-deletes one MeasurementSet via _delete_set teardown; no residual seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 locked-viewer fix is fully covered by: backend/tests/test_measurement_sketch_service.py (service-level 409 on locked PUT to any of field_complete/office_verified/locked), backend/tests/test_measurement_sketch_api_live.py (HTTP-level 409 on locked PUT after transitioning revision through the status ladder), and mobile/src/tests/roof_sketch_locked_viewer.node.test.js (client-side fault isolation of currentSketchMutation, loadSketchDraft, cache.sketch). GET on locked is not asserted with an explicit status check in the live suite but is guaranteed structurally by get_sketch having no editability gate and by the mobile viewer test which exercises the full read-only render path. If a future iteration wants to pin GET-on-locked=200 at the HTTP level, add one more requests.get(...) assertion after the status ladder in test_measurement_sketch_api_live.py.
rca of the issue: N/A — validation pass only; fix from previous iteration already merged and confirmed working.
